records.source_title: Sika Group - home page
records.excerpt: Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide.
records.does_not_establish: It gives no split of sales between professional, industrial and retail or individual buyers.

records.source_title: Sika Group - home page
records.excerpt: In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.
records.does_not_establish: Group sales say nothing about how much comes from DIY or home-improvement retail channels.

records.source_title: Annual Report 2025 - Sika AG
records.excerpt: Sika is a pioneer in the development of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting in the construction and automotive industries. The company is active in eight target markets: Concrete, Waterproofing, Roofing, Building Finishing, Flooring, Sealing & Bonding, Engineered Refurbishment, and Industry.
records.does_not_establish: None of the eight target markets is a consumer or DIY market, and no sales figure is given for any of them.

records.source_title: Annual Report 2025 - Sika AG
records.excerpt: Products reach customers globally through distributors, e-commerce, and direct channels.
records.population: Sika customers and routes to market
records.does_not_establish: It gives no share of sales by channel and does not say whether e-commerce reaches private buyers.

records.source_title: Annual Report 2025 - Sika AG
records.excerpt: Sika’s specialized solutions (e.g., roofing systems, industrial flooring, structural adhesives) often require trained applicators and strict adherence with technical standards. These products are not marketed for DIY or general retail because improper application could lead to performance failures or safety hazards.
records.population: Sika specialized systems and their applicators
records.does_not_establish: It covers only specialized systems and does not say which other Sika products are sold through DIY retail.

records.source_title: Sika Pro Select Products - Sika USA Retail
records.excerpt: For over 20 years, Sika has worked closely with our retail partners to offer pro contractors and DIY'ers the same superior performing products developed and used on the most spectacular projects throughout the world. Our Sika Pro Select product range encompasses a wide array of specialty construction products from sealants and adhesives to patchers and underlayments.
records.population: Pro contractors and DIY buyers in US retail
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how much the US retail range sells or how many buyers are private individuals rather than contractors.

records.source_title: Sika Sealants for DIY | Sika Ireland
records.excerpt: Explore Sika’s range of DIY sealants, designed to deliver professional results for home improvement and maintenance projects. Suitable for a variety of interior and exterior applications, these easy-to-use products offer excellent adhesion, flexibility and durability on common building surfaces.
records.does_not_establish: It does not show that the DIY range is differentiated from the trade range or how well it sells.

records.source_title: Sika Products | Sika Canada
records.excerpt: Sika offers a complete range of construction and landscaping products, including the renowned Sakrete products, perfectly suited to the needs of homeowners and contractors.
records.does_not_establish: It does not separate homeowner from contractor purchases or give any sales figure.

records.source_title: Sika Acquires Leading UK Manufacturer of Sealants and Adhesives
records.excerpt: The acquisition will strengthen Sika’s position in the construction chemical market and in the professional distribution and do-it-yourself channels.
records.does_not_establish: It states an aim from 2013 and does not show what share of UK sales the DIY channel reached afterwards.

records.source_title: Sika UK Distribution
records.excerpt: As the market-leading provider of all trade and construction products for Builders’ Merchants, Trade Professionals, and DIYers, we understand the importance of having the best product for the job.

records.does_not_establish: The market-leadership claim is the company's own and the page gives no split between trade and DIY buyers.

records.source_title: Sika buys Everbuild Building Products - DIY Week
records.excerpt: Sika has acquired Everbuild, the UK's largest independent manufacturer of sealants, adhesives and construction chemicals, to help strengthen its position in the builder's merchant market. Everbuild, which is located in Leeds, has an annual sales revenue in excess of £60 million and a workforce of 270 employees.
records.does_not_establish: The 2013 figures do not show Everbuild's current size or how much of it is sold to home users.

records.source_title: SikaSeal® Sanitary Silicone White 295ml | Toolstation
records.excerpt: Need a silicone sealant that excels in damp or humid conditions? Make sure you've got this Everbuild Everflex 500 bath and sanitary silicone - it's the perfect choice for sealing baths, showers or basins, as well as sanitary fixings and ceramics.
records.population: Buyers at a UK trade and DIY retailer
records.does_not_establish: A retailer listing shows availability, not sales volume or whether buyers are homeowners or tradespeople.

records.source_title: Sikaflex Single Component Polyurethane Sealant - Cool Tools
records.excerpt: It comes in a wide variety of colors, Home Depot carries a limited assortment of colors, but the masonry supply place I do business with has them all – at a higher price.
records.does_not_establish: A single reader's experience does not show how widespread limited retail assortment is.

records.source_title: Sikaflex Single Component Polyurethane Sealant - Cool Tools

records.source_title: DIY Global | Bostik Global
records.excerpt: With a DIY and consumer range of more than 2,000 products, our brands are trusted for a wide range of applications. Our presence extends over 120 countries, allowing us to service retailers worldwide.

records.source_title: Bostik Launches Professional-Grade Sealants & Adhesives on Amazon
records.excerpt: Bostik is pleased to announce that a curated selection of its professional-grade sealants and adhesives is now available for purchase on Amazon. This strategic move brings Bostik’s trusted solutions directly to consumers and contractors, providing convenient access to high-performance products for common household and jobsite applications
records.population: Bostik professional-grade sealants and adhesives sold online
records.does_not_establish: A launch announcement does not show whether the Amazon listings sold well.

records.source_title: Our Brands - Henkel Adhesive Technologies
records.excerpt: Pattex provides reliable adhesives for a wide range of bonding needs, from everyday repairs to complex construction. Trusted by tradespeople and DIYers alike, Pattex products ensure strong, lasting bonds across materials—indoors and outdoors, small-scale or large-scale—with tailored tools for every challenge.
records.does_not_establish: It is Henkel's description of its own brand and gives no sales or market-share figure for Pattex.

records.source_title: Global home improvement market shrank by 1.9 percent in 2024 - DIY International
records.excerpt: In contrast to the global trend, nominal sales in the home improvement market in North America and Europe grew slightly in 2024, with increases of 1.6 percent and 1.2 percent respectively. Without the sharp decline in China, the global home improvement market would have grown by 1.5 percent in 2024.
records.does_not_establish: Total home-improvement retail growth says nothing about demand for sealants and adhesives specifically.

records.source_title: Americans Kept Fixing Up Their Homes Through the Pandemic - Pro Remodeler
records.excerpt: In 2019, four in 10 home improvements were do-it-yourself projects. Yet, despite DIY spending levels remaining relatively stable since 2015, the share of DIY spending that year as it related to all of home improvement fell to a new low, 17% of total home improvement spending.
records.does_not_establish: The 2019 figures predate the pandemic and do not break out spending on sealants, adhesives or waterproofing.

records.source_title: Training requirement for products containing diisocyanates - Health and Safety Authority
records.excerpt: All professional and industrial users of products containing diisocyanate at a concentration of 0.1% or more, e.g. polyurethane adhesives or sealants, must have successfully completed training on how to safely handle products containing diisocyanates by 24 August 2023.
records.population: Professional and industrial users of polyurethane adhesives and sealants
records.does_not_establish: It covers professional use only and does not state the separate rules for selling such products to consumers.

records.source_title: About Consumer Products Program - California Air Resources Board
records.excerpt: For more than thirty years, CARB has taken actions pertaining to the regulation of consumer products. Three regulations have set VOC limits for over 130 consumer product categories.
records.population: Makers and sellers of consumer products in California
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the VOC limits for sealants or adhesives or show whether Sika's products meet them.
